description: The real author of this asset is o4saken ... I only changed a few vertices and added a new 'base scalp' then I created textures with Blender strands on a transparent background . label: Carré droit
author: MargaretToigo
description: This is a blunt bob hairstyle that will go on most humans. Some slight adjustments may be needed for toddler senior and plus-size humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Illustration shows hair with Subsurf of two. Three additional colors are available in Materials.

I will add a text to the 'unofficial plugins' folder with a workaround. For the material: best to plugin the color input of the glossy shader to the output of the diffuse texture in cycles.

label: Bouclé Alpha
author: punkduck
description: This is an adaptation of curly hairstyle MH alpha 7 version . The licence was GPL but author was set to unknown. So I consider it CC BY but the author is the MH team. The adaptation was no rocket science. I changed the texture a bit so that the hairline looks slightly better. The example picture is from MH and shows the black material on my 'Evi' character.

label: Bouclé Alpha 2
author: punkduck
description: This is an adaptation of curly 2 hairstyle MH alpha 7 version . The licence was GPL but author was set to unknown. So I consider it CC BY but the author is the MH team. The adaptation was no rocket science. I changed the texture a bit so that the hair does not contain skin parts. Furthermore I added 2 materials. The materials are using the litspheres lit_refl_sharp.png in MH. If it does not work use the material editor and change it to none. The example picture is from MH and shows the 'raven' material which I specially made for afro-american females.
